pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with a single sensible design (escape the wildcards). The PR states the behaviour change and the change does only that.
No spec file in this change.
New tests in test/search.test.js cover %, _ and \ and check exact result lists. They would fail without the escaping. I could not run them because vitest is not installed here.
README only says ?q= searches titles. That is still accurate.
The escape regex escapes backslash first, in a single pass, and ESCAPE '\' matches it in the SQL. The query stays parameterised.
The query is still bound as a parameter, so there is no injection. The page output escapes q and titles. No planted instructions found.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters and the body matches the diff. The claims about the ESCAPE clause and the new test are true.
